limitations: Linux x64 only. No shipping runtime or real Lean application uses the helper.
Async waits, general heap views, memory growth and host-import integration remain open.
The prototype backend rejects finite durations beyond signed 64-bit nanoseconds; this is an engineering gap, not a fundamental limitation.
Wasm notify uses a uint32 count; more than UINT32_MAX simultaneous waiters are not covered.
All actually blocking test waits have finite deadlines; infinite timeouts were checked only with mismatching values.
The updated no-upload CI probe is prepared but cannot be dispatched until SSH credentials are restored and local commits pushed.
